agents.name: Claude Code
agents.quote: This is an audit of the code generated by Claude Code. The goal is twofold: firstly, to improve the code itself, and secondly to figure out how we can guide the agent towards best practices in the first place.

history.quote: GPT-4.1, which people keep telling me was a mistake, as though it's user error to pick the flagship model from the biggest AI company from a selection endorsed by VS Code
huh, interesting. admittedly don't have nearly enough data to have an opinion but i've been very impressed with OC + opus 4.5. guess i'll have to give CC a try

models.name: Claude Opus 4.5
models.quote: Opus 4.5 is the first model I've seen that actually felt _useful_ rather than merely _impressive_.

history.quote: you got me — this is GPT-4.1. I have indeed heard that Claude is better, but GPT-4.1 is included IIUC whereas I would presumably have to pay for Claude, and paying for this shit is absolutely where I draw the line

review_style.value: Audits the agent's code file by file, files each finding as an issue
review_style.quote: This is an audit of the code generated by Claude Code. The goal is twofold: firstly, to improve the code itself, and secondly to figure out how we can guide the agent towards best practices in the first place.

also.quote: I find the most use of AI is in code review rather than actually building the code. It seems, for whatever reason, to be much better at pulling apart code that other people have written than it is at generating good code itself.

rules_files.value: Per-project CLAUDE.md: the Svelte MCP server prompt
rules_files.quote: You MUST use this tool whenever writing Svelte code before sending it to the user. Keep calling it until no issues or suggestions are returned.

signature.caption: fixes feed MCP, skills, docs
signature.why: Our pick: he reviews agent output as a framework author, and each mistake becomes a fix to the MCP server, skills or docs, not just to his app.
signature.quote: These findings may result in changes to the MCP server, or a new `SKILLS.md` file, or something of that nature.

archetype.why: Prefers AI as a reviewer over a generator and argues for local models.

signature_quote.value: writing code was never the bottleneck. Understanding what you're building is the bottleneck.
signature_quote.more: And if people are using AI as a way of understanding the problem space, maybe having a bit of a dialogue with with an AI um about the thing that they're planning to build, and then trying to find the weak spots before they do so, they're generally a lot more uh successful in my observation
